Using the determinant formula, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}u\times v & =|\begin{aligned}i & j & k \\ 7 & 3 & -4 \\ -1 & -4 & 3\end{aligned}| \\  & =|\begin{aligned}3 & -4 \\ -4 & 3\end{aligned}|i-|\begin{aligned}7 & -4 \\ -1 & 3\end{aligned}|j+|\begin{aligned}7 & 3 \\ -1 & -4\end{aligned}|k \\  & =(3\cdot 3-(-4)\cdot (-4))i-(7\cdot 3-(-4)\cdot (-1))j+(7\cdot (-4)-(3)\cdot (-1))k \\  & =(9-16)i-(21-4)j+(-28+3)k \\  & =-7i-17j-25k.\end{aligned}
$$
